card.name: Inside 'prophylaxis' and mid-instruction words
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'yl' in 'prophylaxis' (as in prophylaxis of gout flares), where the word is only partly written. Also some partial words or small words in step-by-step instructions, like 'inc' before 'ision' or 'on' after 'thumb'.

modes.label: Prophylaxis
modes.description: The 'yl' part of 'prophylaxis' in dosing text for preventing gout flares or similar.
